usage.guide: Call POST https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/upscale-image with JSON body {"image_url":"<public image URL>"} and pay $0.10 USDC via x402 on Base. The required field is image_url (omitting it returns 400 'Missing image_url field'). WARNING: this endpoint is currently broken — it charges $0.10 even on failure, and in QA it returned 502 'Upscaling failed: Unprocessable Entity' for a valid public image. Avoid until upstream is fixed; the working output shape is unknown.
